generation.notes: Written by a sub-agent of the orchestrating Claude Code session from the final brief, with no person involved. A sample is the pair (scan i + 1, scan i); scans are cut to data_quality metres, lose their ground points and are thinned on a fixed 0.3 m grid before any item, and every item runs exactly `iterations` rounds of point-to-point ICP. About 42 ms per item at default settings and about 170 ms at the heaviest; at 6 m only a handful of points remain, so an item takes under 1 ms there.
